evidence: Initializes the caller-provided 32-bit output to 0xffffffff, then queries attribute_context_status_value_get with selector 0x13. Statuses 1, 3, 4, 7, 8, or 5 reach f_7001812550 with 0xffff arguments; its low 16-bit result is sign-extended and stored to the output. Other statuses leave the output at -1. The helper result domain is not established, so the name describes only the observed gated signed-result store (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:6118-6156).

Calls f_70008bbc30 with the input record and a local status output, and proceeds only when it returns true. It updates record fields at +0x254, +0x258, and +0x25c using context/global helpers, then calls the established populate_nested_player_attribute_block helper with the record, selected nested block, and status byte. The exact meanings of the selector and fields are not known, so the name stays at the visible conditional helper flow (decompiled/main/main_0111.c:11861-11889).

Sets byte +0x221 on the input record, queries context selector 0x13, then checks a global context pointer through helper predicates. When the checks pass, it sets byte +0x222. Its indexed caller tail-calls it from the same record-processing path, but does not establish more specific meanings for the two flags (decompiled/main/main_0073.c:21203-21238; caller decompiled/main/main_0073.c:8888-8891).

Returns the sentinel -2 when the object byte at +0x42a is clear or context selector 0x13 reports status 6 or 7. Otherwise it returns input values 0, 1, or 2 unchanged and maps larger positive values to 3; negative inputs return -2. The indexed caller passes a context object and index and consumes the result in a status-processing path (decompiled/main/main_0116.c:14011-14049; caller decompiled/main/main_0113.c:33782-33785).

Checks two input bytes, the context selector-0x13 status, and a computed slot value. When the slot value is within the observed 0..0x1d range, it sets byte +0x108 at the computed entry address. Indexed callers include dispatch_attribute_context_entry_processing and build_context_ranked_entry_table, supporting the conservative context-entry table wording without asserting field types (decompiled/main/main_0049.c:45987-46024; callers decompiled/main/main_0054.c:41990-41994, 42064-42068).
